fusions.name: Headsman's Drop
fusions.desc: Rears up and drops your horns on a target at or below 25% health for 24 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cleaving Toss
fusions.desc: Tosses your horns through a 3-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 28 slashing damage to everything caught. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Whetstone Rub
fusions.desc: Whets your horns, raising your slashing damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Notch for Notch
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 17% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
